target_files_utf8.content/training/day1-basic-competencies:
## [purpose] Purpose

In a sample health-station and field-visit setting, identify five hazard groups and match one observed hazard to potential harm, immediate control and reporting contact.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

45 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Use a paper scenario, not a hazardous work area. Prepare the local reporting contact.

## [opening] Opening

The entrance floor is wet. Which report supports immediate action?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The first report gives location, risk and action. A reminder alone does not remove the hazard; absence of injury now is no reason to wait.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Misses the hazard or gives only “be careful” as the response. Recognizing a hazard should lead to a specific control and responsible contact.

## [practice] Practice activity

Draw five boxes: needlestick injury; infection exposure; body discomfort; stress from excessive work; work-related accidents. Give a station or home-visit example for each. Choose one and write the harm, control and contact. In pairs, replace a vague “be careful” with a specific action. Alone, use the checklist. Before the next duty, perform a short hazard check.

## [answer-key] Answer key

1. “Wet entrance, slip risk; keep people away and arrange correction with responsible staff.”

The first report gives location, risk and action. A reminder alone does not remove the hazard; absence of injury now is no reason to wait.

## [observe] Observe

Identifies all five hazard groups and gives potential harm, immediate control and a reporting contact for the chosen example.

Ready: Identifies all five hazard groups and gives potential harm, immediate control and a reporting contact for the chosen example. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Names the hazard but omits contact or control; complete all four fields and repeat.

Not yet: Misses the hazard or gives only “be careful” as the response.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Names the hazard but omits contact or control; complete all four fields and repeat. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

## [purpose] Layunin

Sa halimbawang health station at field visit, tukuyin ang limang uri ng panganib at ipares ang isang nakitang panganib sa posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at reporting contact.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

45 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Gamitin ang scenario sa papel, hindi tunay na mapanganib na lugar. Ihanda ang lokal na reporting contact.

## [opening] Pambungad

May basang sahig sa pasukan. Aling ulat ang magagamit agad?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang unang ulat ay may lugar, panganib at aksyon. Ang paalala lamang ay hindi nag-aalis ng panganib; ang kawalan ng pinsala ngayon ay hindi dahilan para maghintay.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Hindi nakikita ang panganib o paalalang “mag-ingat” lang ang aksyon. Ang pagkilala sa panganib ay dapat humantong sa tiyak na kontrol at taong tutugon.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Iguhit ang limang kahon: tusok ng karayom; exposure sa impeksyon; pananakit ng katawan; stress sa sobrang trabaho; aksidente sa gawain. Magbigay ng isang halimbawa sa bawat isa mula sa station o home visit. Pumili ng isa at isulat ang pinsala, kontrol at contact. Sa pares, suriin kung “mag-ingat” lang ang kontrol at palitan ng tiyak na aksyon. Kung mag-isa, gamitin ang checklist. Bago ang susunod na duty, magsagawa ng maikling hazard check.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

1. “Basang pasukan, panganib madulas; ilayo muna ang tao at ipatama sa responsableng staff.”

Ang unang ulat ay may lugar, panganib at aksyon. Ang paalala lamang ay hindi nag-aalis ng panganib; ang kawalan ng pinsala ngayon ay hindi dahilan para maghintay.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Natutukoy ang limang hazard group; sa napiling halimbawa, may posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at taong lalapitan.

Kaya na: Natutukoy ang limang hazard group; sa napiling halimbawa, may posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at taong lalapitan. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Natutukoy ang panganib ngunit kulang ang contact o kontrol; ipapunan ang apat na field bago ulitin.

Hindi pa: Hindi nakikita ang panganib o paalalang “mag-ingat” lang ang aksyon.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Natutukoy ang panganib ngunit kulang ang contact o kontrol; ipapunan ang apat na field bago ulitin. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [ana] Before Ana starts work

Ana, 33, will assist at the health station before household visits. The entrance floor is wet, the sharps box is nearly full and a hot walk lies ahead. “I will be careful” is not enough. She identifies each hazard, who might be harmed and the control needed. She checks the local protocol and confirms the reporting contact and tasks within her training with the midwife.

## [inspect] Inspect a work area

A fictional station has a wet floor, a blocked exit and no soap at the sink. For each, name the hazard, possible harm, immediate control and reporting contact. First keep people away from danger and seek the right assistance. A checklist that only says “be careful” is incomplete. Check that the problem is corrected before removing the warning.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Draw five boxes: needlestick injury; infection exposure; body discomfort; stress from excessive work; work-related accidents. Give a station or home-visit example for each. Choose one and write the harm, control and contact. In pairs, replace a vague “be careful” with a specific action. Alone, use the checklist. Before the next duty, perform a short hazard check.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [ana] Bago simulan ni Ana ang araw

Si Ana, 33 anyos, ay BHW na tutulong sa health station bago mag-household visit. May basang sahig sa pasukan, halos puno ang sharps box at mainit ang nakaabang na lakad. Hindi sapat ang “mag-iingat ako.” Tinutukoy niya ang hazard, sino ang maaaring masaktan, at anong kontrol ang kailangan. Tinitingnan niya ang lokal na protocol at kinukumpirma sa midwife kung kanino mag-uulat at alin lang ang gawaing saklaw ng kanyang pagsasanay.

## [inspect] Suriin ang isang work area

Sa kathang-isip na station, may basang sahig, nakaharang na labasan at walang sabon sa hugasan. Para sa bawat isa, sabihin ang hazard, maaaring epekto, agarang kontrol at taong aabisuhan. Unahin ang paglayo ng tao sa panganib at paghingi ng tamang tulong. Hindi kumpleto ang checklist kung ang nakasulat ay “mag-ingat” lamang. Balikan kung naayos ang problema bago alisin ang babala.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Iguhit ang limang kahon: tusok ng karayom; exposure sa impeksyon; pananakit ng katawan; stress sa sobrang trabaho; aksidente sa gawain. Magbigay ng isang halimbawa sa bawat isa mula sa station o home visit. Pumili ng isa at isulat ang pinsala, kontrol at contact. Sa pares, suriin kung “mag-ingat” lang ang kontrol at palitan ng tiyak na aksyon. Kung mag-isa, gamitin ang checklist. Bago ang susunod na duty, magsagawa ng maikling hazard check.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.
